notes_for_editor: Only the FFLA county list says anything about this tower. Several searches and the local history pages checked turned up nothing on its builder, date, design, staffing, fires or fate. The DHR page is town context only, not tower history. The FFLA point 36.67284, -78.86059 is unverified. The story is shorter than the 120-word guide floor because the evidence is this thin. A local Halifax County history source would be the next step if a fuller story is wanted. Fact-check 2026-10-21: story wording no longer copies the register text, and the no-source sentence is limited to the sources checked.
